previous_audits.verdict_rationale: The retarded-front calculation and ordinary teleportation identities are genuine finite computations, but the purported controlled-unitary check evaluates projector idempotence rather than constructing or testing U = sum_j P_j tensor U_j. The bath calculation inserts analytic overlap formulas and traces a static coherence matrix; a finite overlap does not prove irreversible decoherence or durable record formation, while equal branch energy follows from fixed codeword length and the ledger commutator acts on a separate tensor factor. The hard-coded state-only/ non-FTL gate is not an executed check. For the bounded-with-named-walls assertion, N1 leaves microscopic-Hamiltonian, thermodynamic-limit, relativistic-carrier, and full-conservation routes open; N2 wall independence is unproved; N3 finds explicit rather than hidden admissions; N4 has no cited residual witness; N5 lacks five-resolution execution; N6 leaves partial-closure candidates unresolved; N7's finite-model steelman fails to supply the missing dynamics; and N8's related apparatus-closure echo remains only partly addressed.
